P1 (The Onramp).why: Source P1 ends at a ledge with several pines; belay there.
P1 (The Onramp).text: Belay on the ledge with several pine trees at the top of the leftward-leaning slab.

P2 (The Superflake).why: Source only says the flake tapers to a spire; belay at the spire not stated for P2 (inferred from P3 start).

P3.why: Source P3: follow the dihedral to a belay nook below a slightly overhanging off-width crack; 'small' removed.
P3.text: Belay in a nook in the dihedral, just below the slightly overhanging wide crack.

P4.why: Source says the pitch ends at an angled ledge; does not place a belay there (inference).

P5 (Gemini Cracks).why: Source says tops out on an angled ledge; no belay stated (inference).

P6 (Sail Headwall).why: Source only says aim for the Solid Gold rappel anchors; belay placement and 'top of headwall' not stated.
